items.name: Crossfire Pin
items.description: Mark one living ordinary target for 1.5s; a different weapon type pulls it toward the saved point by up to 45px.
items.trigger: Primary hits from two distinct weapon types
items.cost: 1 module slot; no extra damage; other targets cannot replace the active mark

items.name: Salvage Capacitor
items.description: Three normal pickups charge a dash-origin slow field: 80px, 1.8s, speed factor 0.70. Energy and medical do not charge.
items.trigger: Dash starts with three charges from actual in-combat normal pickups; settlement sweep excluded
items.cost: 1 module slot; no damage; bosses and committed charges unaffected; at most two fields

items.name: Medic Winch
items.description: Every five normal pickups pull the nearest medical orb within 220px toward you by up to 80px. Requires medical pickups, currently from Medic Seed. At most one pull per same-step collection batch (同一批收集最多牵引一次); extra thresholds are spent.
items.trigger: Fifth actual in-combat normal pickup; settlement sweep excluded; chance spent even without medicine
items.cost: 1 module slot; no healing, new orb, or remote collection; energy and medical do not count

mechanism_synergies.name: Crossfire Control
mechanism_synergies.description: Two different currently equipped weapon types mark then pull one ordinary target. No extra damage; one mark at a time.

mechanism_synergies.name: Salvage Field
mechanism_synergies.description: Three actual in-combat normal pickups charge a dash-origin slow field. Medical, energy and settlement rewards excluded. Inventory resets each room.

mechanism_synergies.name: Medical Recovery
mechanism_synergies.description: Medic Seed supplies existing medical orbs. Every five actual combat normal pickups request one pull; at most one per same batch. No direct healing; no target still spends the request.
